summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_macrotrack.py with 7 new cases covering all 5 new endpoints (food-search, parse-food-text, recipes CRUD, weekly-summary, water-log DELETE). Full suite run via pytest against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL: 17/17 passed in 20.4s. All iteration-1 regressions (Gemini /analyze-food on real food JPEG + Open Food Facts barcode 737628064502 Thai Kitchen) still pass. _id field absent from every response. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~600 lines — still under the 700-line split threshold, but recipes/weekly-summary/parse-food-text are logically distinct and could be moved to separate routers if growth continues.

/api/food-search swallows ALL upstream exceptions and returns {results: []} (line 417). This hides Open Food Facts outages from the client; consider returning 502 on network errors so the UI can show a retry banner.
/api/parse-food-text uses Gemini for every call (no caching). Frequent identical inputs (e.g. 'one banana') will incur cost; consider a simple in-memory or DB cache keyed by normalized text.

DELETE endpoints (/api/recipes/{rid}, /api/water-log/{wid}, /api/food-log/{id}) always return 200 with {deleted: 0|1}. Returning 404 when deleted==0 would be more RESTful, but current contract is consistent across endpoints.
weekly-summary multiplies food calories by servings (line 575) but the single-day GET /api/food-log does not — confirm the UI aggregation matches this convention to avoid double-multiplying.
No max-size guard on /api/analyze-food image_base64 (carried over from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed rows (TEST_Smoothie recipe, TEST_Apple food-log, water/weight/activity entries) and delete them inline; no residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_macrotrack.py covers all 15 endpoints (17 test cases). Gemini calls (analyze-food, parse-food-text) need ~5-20s; timeouts set to 120s. Open Food Facts is the live upstream for /food-search and /barcode-lookup. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the only base URL used.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all tests passing, no bugs found.
